newsitem.title: FINLAND: ROCLA OY SAYS MAY SEEK BOURSE LISTING THIS YEAR.
newsitem.headline: ROCLA OY SAYS MAY SEEK BOURSE LISTING THIS YEAR.

text.p: Finnish electric warehouse vehicle maker Rockla Oy said on Tuesday it was preparing for a possible listing on the Helsinki bourse this year.

"Rocla Oy ... has undertaken preparations for a possible listing on the Helsinki Stock Exchange later this year," Rocla said in a statement, adding that it had chosen Carnegie as its adviser and lead manager in the possible listing.
Rocla said its shareholders meeting on April 23 had authorised the board of directors to increase the share capital through a rights issue targeted at retail investors and employees.
Retail investors and employees would be offered for subscription a minimum of 100,000 and a maximum of 425,000 new Rocla shares with a nominal value of five markka each, it said.
Rocla, which manufactures electrically powered warehouse trucks and automated guided vehicles, said its 1996 earnings were "the best ever in the company's 54-year history."

Profit after financial items more than doubled in 1996, rising to 13.3 million markka from 5.7 million in 1995, while net sales rose to 225.6 million markka from 190.6 million a year earlier, it said.
